offer.message: Patricia, I'm doing you a favor here, file it however you want. Henry's a Hall of Famer, Ward's got real starts in him, that's two actual names for one running back. Binder says yes. Sign it, send it back before Sunday - I've already moved on either way.

Clear eyes, full heart, and a third quarterback I don't need anymore — call it a test of character, Coach. Deshaun Watson's got more name recognition than everyone on your bench combined, and all I want back is a rookie running back nobody's watching yet. Prove to me you know a gift when you see one.
